name: http_client
description: Make HTTP requests from SQL — GET, POST (JSON), and POST (form-encoded) — with custom headers and parameters. Returns a struct of {status, reason, body, headers} that JSON-extracts cleanly. For ad-hoc API calls and low-volume integrations.

cta.title: HTTP Calls in SELECT
cta.description: Install HTTP Client to make GET / POST requests directly from DuckDB queries — perfect for joining a database with an API.
